summary: John's 2nd cousin 8x removed (Job → Job 2d → Anna → Temperance); NOT John's ancestor Temperance Tuttle.
bio: Married Jonas Platt, her stepbrother (her widowed mother Anna married Jonas's father Zephaniah Platt). Jonas died in 1775 aged 44; she died 12 Mar 1813 his widow. Children included Col. Richard Platt.
